targets.quote: The long-term vision is that in 2050, the EU will be a climate-resilient society, fully adapted to the unavoidable impacts of climate change.
targets.label: goal

targets.quote: This means that by 2050, when we aim to have reached climate neutrality, we will have reinforced adaptive capacity and minimised vulnerability to climate impacts, in line with the Paris Agreement and the proposed European Climate Law
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: The proposal commits the EU and its Member States to make continuous progress to boost adaptive capacity, strengthen resilience and reduce vulnerability to climate change.
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: The strategy aims to realise the 2050 vision of a climate-resilient Union by making adaptation smarter, more systemic, swifter, and by stepping up international action.
targets.article: Section 2 — Four objectives of the strategy
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Full implementation of the actions of the strategy would put Europe in a much better position to face climate impacts already by 2030.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: oimprove the state of the art on adaptation modelling, risk assessment and management tools – towards “asset-level modelling”.
targets.article: Section 4 — Pushing the frontiers of knowledge
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: oestablish a European climate and health observatory under Climate-ADAPT.
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: oupgrade adaptation monitoring, reporting and evaluation by using a harmonised framework of standards and indicators;
targets.article: Section 8 — Improving adaptation strategies and plans
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: At least 37% of the allocation of the plans should be directed to climate action covering both mitigation and adaptation efforts.
targets.article: Section 10 — Integrating resilience in national fiscal frameworks
targets.label: target

targets.quote: ostep up support to planning and implementation of local adaptation and launch an adaptation support facility under the EU Covenant of Mayors;
targets.article: Section 9 — Fostering local, individual and just resilience
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: The EU increased the spending target for climate action to 30% in its long-term budget for 2021-2027, with adaptation as a key component.
targets.label: target

targets.quote: The aim of this strategy is therefore to shift the focus to developing and rolling out solutions, to help reduce climate risk, increase climate protection, and safeguard freshwater access.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: The Mission proposal aims to support 200 communities to develop solutions for transformative adaptation, and scale up 100 deep demonstrations of climate-resilience.
targets.article: Section 13 — Accelerating the rollout of adaptation solutions
targets.label: target

targets.quote: odevelop an EU-wide climate risk assessment and strengthen climate considerations in EU disaster risk prevention and management;
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: Ultimately, the mechanism this strategy puts in place will lead to national-level assessments of insurance penetration rates and recommendations to improve them.
targets.article: Section 15 — Closing the climate protection gap
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: osubmit the EU's adaptation plans and actions under the Paris Agreement;
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: oaim to increase international climate finance for adaptation through the EU instruments for external action and by leveraging private sector investments;
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: oenhance the climate proofing of all EU external investments and actions.
targets.label: commitment
